result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken/missing image placeholder (gray box with a broken-image icon) instead of a restaurant photo, which looks visually broken. Other elements (carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport) are expected behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: The featured card image under 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) failed to load and displays a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of a photo, making the card look broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly (fix URL/asset reference), and provide a graceful fallback such as a branded gradient or cached thumbnail instead of the raw broken-image placeholder icon.

issues.description: The broken-image placeholder icon is centered in a large empty gray area, which emphasizes the empty state; the '€0 delivery' badge and heart button float over an otherwise blank card.
issues.suggestion: If an image is unavailable, style the fallback state intentionally (e.g., restaurant logo or cuisine illustration on a tinted background) so badges and buttons sit on meaningful content.
